summary:
A single continuous ten-second urban-fantasy opening in which the Weaver detects a snapped cosmic thread, catches it and sends it down toward the sleeping city. No temporal keyframes and no pose holds.

detailed_description:
[One continuous unbroken shot, 00:00-00:10] Begin gliding forward through the three-dimensional web from <Picture 2>; nearby filaments drift past the lens at different depths and every thread carries subtle moving pulses. At 00:02 a single hair-thin filament stretches, frays and snaps with a sharp blue-white spark; its ends recoil naturally. The camera follows the recoiling end and reveals <Subject 1> already crawling fluidly across the web, every leg alternating with real mechanical weight. Without stopping, the Weaver reaches, clamps the line with two front limbs and pulls backward while the remaining legs brace and adjust. The tension wave travels along surrounding threads. At 00:07 the camera races along the taut cobalt filament through dark cloud and descends toward a modern Asian city at night, ending on the filament touching one rooftop as rain begins. Movement remains continuous and causal; no tableau, no frozen pause, no hard cut.

Deep cosmic resonance, fine thread vibration, one crystalline snap, rhythmic bronze mechanisms, rushing high-altitude wind and distant city rain.
